lines: Closer to me than anyone, yet that voice I couldn't hear (sister's noise... I find it out...)
In the time that kept ticking on, at last I could meet you
Sister's noise, I keep searching for where my wandering heart belongs (sorrow of your heart... I shoot it down...)
These feelings we've woven together, no one can ever break them...!
The city quietly kept you hidden
The place I finally reached, that memory comes back to life
It kept repeating over and over, the truth was far away
Your pain stayed there, and I never noticed it
Even if the dream you entrusted to me that day tears me apart
More than anything, I'll hold true to hope alone
Living as myself — that's what I want to tell you more than anything (sister's noise... I find it out...)
If I carve out the meaning of the pain of sorrow that keeps being born
Sister's voice, I'll deliver it now, turning even my tears into strength (sorrow of your heart... I shoot it down...)
Only the strength that binds us together will pierce through everything
An after-school dusk, the streets as always
I happened to look up at the sky, and remember your kindness
Your gaze is what made me realize it
The strength of the courage to accept one's own weakness
Your warm hand has been guiding me
More than anything I want to protect it — hope pierces through the darkness
The burning longing I hold in my arms will light up this world (sister's noise... I find it out...)
I kept running, kept searching — your dream begins to move
Sister's noise, it starts to resound, the soaring meaning of life (sorrow of your heart... I shoot it down...)
I know it well — an irreplaceable bond will never break
Living as myself — that's what I want to tell you more than anything (sister's noise... I find it out...)
If I carve out the meaning of the pain of sorrow that keeps being born
Closer to me than anyone, yet that voice I couldn't hear (sister's noise... I find it out...)
In the time that kept ticking on, at last I could meet you
Sister's noise, I keep searching for where my wandering heart belongs (sorrow of your heart... I shoot it down...)
We felt it together, the same smile — I swear I'll protect it
No one can ever break it now...!
